reason: The plugin is clearly a session-search utility for DeepSeek Harness users, described as cross-session full-text retrieval in local logs with configurable scope and limits, making its primary purpose searchable retrieval of historical agent conversations. Its supported behavior and outputs are documented around `session_search`, line-level hits, and session metadata, fitting the Search & Browsing category.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在本地 DSH 会话中按关键词进行全文检索，扫描会话日志并返回命中的会话与具体文本片段，帮助用户快速定位历史讨论内容。
summaries.en: This plugin performs keyword-based full-text search across local DSH sessions, scanning session logs and returning matching sessions with hit snippets to quickly locate past conversation content.

capabilities: Full-text keyword search across local DeepSeek Harness sessions via session_search.
Supports both compressed `.jsonl.zstd` and plaintext `.jsonl` session log formats.
Returns matched session metadata (title/ID/workdir) and hit line details for retrieval.
